f_01KXAYS6ABBDMJD6DCVE3CBYJB.subject: addition_footprint_dimensions
f_01KXAYS6ABBDMJD6DCVE3CBYJB.content: The addition is a two-story structure approximately 30' x 10', comprising basement-level storage and a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXAYS6ABFM476NXDENV8NP92.subject: lvl_beam_specification
f_01KXAYS6ABFM476NXDENV8NP92.content: Scope includes one 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" to open an existing load-bearing wall, with temporary shoring included.

f_01KXAYS6ABYC0ZVD5R6FQ00JEZ.subject: elevator_shaft_scope
f_01KXAYS6ABYC0ZVD5R6FQ00JEZ.content: Scope includes framing a future elevator shaft (approx. 4'x4'); the elevator system itself is explicitly excluded and listed as a change-order trigger.

f_01KXAYS6AB72X738WVKEW54ZJ8.subject: subpanel_scope
f_01KXAYS6AB72X738WVKEW54ZJ8.content: Electrical scope includes a 100A subpanel with full rough-in and trim-out.

f_01KXAYS6ABT4951AM64NYKX7W8.subject: window_door_count
f_01KXAYS6ABT4951AM64NYKX7W8.content: Scope includes 4 windows (three 36"x60" and one transom) and one new exterior door.

f_01KXAYS6ABAE04QN9VRX399R41.subject: roof_pitch_tie_in
f_01KXAYS6ABAE04QN9VRX399R41.content: New gable roof is specified at 3/12 pitch tying into the existing 6/12 pitch roof; truss vs. rafter decision is TBD pending the design phase.

f_01KXAYS6ABYXB8KH02K59Q1KZH.subject: septic_inspection_required
f_01KXAYS6ABYXB8KH02K59Q1KZH.content: TDEC septic inspection is required per scope; septic relocation, replacement, or grinder pump installation is excluded and is a change-order trigger.

f_01KXAYS6ACRP6WK3D7DC29BYMC.content: The breakdown CSV and architectural drawings are both titled 'Simons Addition / Simons Residence'; the app_project customer is john cooper at 308 Evergreen Street, Church Hill, TN.

f_01KXAYS6AC3YADXW5CEKSV4JAV.subject: exterior_finish_spec
f_01KXAYS6AC3YADXW5CEKSV4JAV.content: Exterior finish requires vinyl siding to match existing; drawings callout specifies 'ADD BRICK TO MATCH EXISTING' at the addition base.

f_01KXAYS6ACDDY6799VY3F4HGVG.content: Explicit change-order triggers include rock excavation, unsuitable soils, additional structural requirements, concealed conditions found during demolition, any septic work, and the elevator system.
